# Identity Decision Checklist: Glitchpad Identity Color Approval

**Purpose**: Review whether S015 requirements define a complete, fair, and constitutionally valid identity-color decision
**Created**: 2026-09-07
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Comparison Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all three owner-revised square-based color directions explicitly required without allowing the recommended direction to bypass equal-context comparison? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Are dark, light, permanent-square, square-edge, page, reduced, monochrome, wordmark, fold, and platform roles required for every direction or explicitly marked inapplicable? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK003 Are desktop, Android launcher, store artwork, lockup, mark-only, and 16/24/32/48 pixel contexts all named as decision evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the relationship between full-color, reduced, and monochrome roles clear enough to prevent accidental role inheritance? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Identity Integrity

- [ ] CHK005 Is byte-identical protected page-path, G-channel, and fold preservation stated consistently while requiring one safe square enclosure without clipping or distortion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-011, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the owner’s authority to approve, adjust, or reject clearly separated from automated accessibility correction authority? [Clarity, Spec §US2, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification prohibit exploratory colors from becoming authoritative before approval across source, generator, generated output, and public presentation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are hue-family changes, textures, effects, and geometry changes explicitly bounded as requiring new evidence or remaining out of scope? [Boundary, Spec §Edge Cases, §Scope]

## Measurement and Accessibility

- [ ] CHK009 Are background and adjacent-fill contrast measurements required for every applicable role without treating those measurements as aesthetic approval? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Are failing candidate-context relationships required to remain visible in the decision evidence rather than being omitted? [Exception Coverage, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 Are light-surface and small-size failure modes called out specifically enough to prevent shape recognition from being mistaken for compliant color treatment? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Are final AA, glyph, production-kit, and site gates measurable and non-exemptable? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-016, §SC-007]

## Decision and Traceability

- [ ] CHK013 Is the approval record required to name exact values, role mappings, rationale, and any inapplicable platform cases? [Completeness, Spec §US2, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK014 Are adjustment and rejection outcomes specified as legitimate states with clear next behavior? [Scenario Coverage, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK015 Is post-approval synchronization required across source roles, shared generator behavior, guidance, measurements, tests, changelog, and output dispositions? [Traceability, Spec §FR-012 through §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 Is issue #146 the sole identity scope, with guideline catalog and link/navigation redesigns explicitly excluded? [Scope, Spec §FR-001, §Scope]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
